_comment: Landmarks in NewWorld.exe, RE'd so future sessions can name addresses instead of re-deriving them. 'va' = virtual address (image base 0x140000000). Add entries as they are confirmed; every va here should be reachable with: python tools/reversing/decomp.py --symbol <name>

worldtype_mapper.what: Maps a string to the WorldType enum: strncmp 'FTUE' (len 4) -> 0, 'OpenWorld' (len 9) -> 1, else 2 (Unknown). Confirms the wire token is the bare 'OpenWorld', not 'eWorldType_OpenWorld'.

worldmetadata_property_table.what: Registration table for the WorldMetadata property set. Each property is registered with a type-specific helper: FUN_144c6c330 (int, 2 args), FUN_144c60a10 (string/object), FUN_144c55a20 (enum), FUN_144c6c550, FUN_144c5b320, FUN_144c6a7f0 (bool). Real property names: worldId, name, type, status, version, publicStatusCode, publicName, maxAccountCharacters, worldSet, worldMetrics (nested WorldMetrics: worldAgeDays, queueSize, queueWaitTimeSec, worldPopulationStatus), transferToRegion, isFull, isRecommended. NOTE: name/type/status, NOT worldName/worldType/worldStatus.
worldmetadata_property_table.found_by: xrefs to the camelCase key block 0x1483c0900, all inside FUN_144f40780

worlds_info_accessor.what: Accessor for the WorldsInfo property (FNV-1a hash map lookup). Called from 0x144f55461 inside the big parser.

big_parser.what: 85 KB function containing the WorldMetadata/WorldMetrics property registration AND the only caller of the WorldsInfo accessor. This is the landing-screen world model: start here when hunting the world-list predicate.
big_parser.found_by: .pdata range containing all WorldMetadata property xrefs

getlogininfo_request_builder.what: Builds the GetLoginInfo/ListWorlds request. Sets 'channelId', 'includeNames', 'isTrialOwner' via FUN_14747e6f0(obj, key, value). Explains the observed query string.

worldtype_mapper_callers.what: One of 4 callers of worldtype_mapper (0x1464272a4). Others: 0x1464582b0, 0x146462b20, 0x146474d00. Candidates for the code that filters worlds by type.

worldmetadata_type_rtti.what: RTTI/type-registration block for the world model family: WorldFilter, WorldMetrics, WorldPublicMetadata, WorldsInfo, UiVitalsStat*.

data_locations.what: UI/login descriptor block: camelCase property name strings (regionId, awsRegion, latencyMs, worldAgeDays, queueSize, queueWaitTimeSec, worldPopulationStatus, publicStatusCode, publicName, maxAccountCharacters, worldSet, worldMetrics, transferToRegion, isFull, isRecommended, eWorldType_*, CharacterMetadata fields, CharacterNameData fields, filterParams, recommendedWorlds).
data_locations.found_by: one xref per key from the property registration code

aws_model_name_table.what: aws-sdk-cpp ListWorldsResponseBody name table (Worlds, PublicName, WorldStatus, WorldType, ...). ZERO xrefs from code and no pointer tables: decorative, not the wire schema. Do not chase this.

login_error_enum.what: Concatenated login error tokens: login_no_worlds, login_no_worlds_unknown, login_world_list_failed, login_character_list_failed, login_failed_to_create_character, login_create_character_rate_limited, TOO_MANY_CHARACTERS_ERROR, TOO_MANY_CHARACTERS_FOR_WORLD, MAINTENANCE_MODE, ... The 'no active worlds in your region' panel string maps here.
